description: Language-agnostic law for the sync card's draft -> typed attach target: null for an empty draft, an absolute native folder, a native file and its parent, or a hub target host:port/space/document. Native file/folder wire tags carry the exact native path after the prefix without percent decoding; HTTP query encoding is separate. A bare remote host:port/document names the default space; host:port alone names the session document. Oracles: WHATWG URL for remote drafts and encoded query round trips, node:path win32/posix dirname for native file parents.

cases.name: an empty draft is no target
an absolute folder stays as it is
a relative folder is made absolute
a file is backed by its folder
a file at the root is backed by the root
a Windows drive folder keeps its native root
a Windows forward-slash file retains its drive
a Windows backslash file retains its separators
a file at a Windows drive root keeps the root separator
a UNC file keeps its native share root
a slash UNC file keeps its share root
native folder names preserve spaces Unicode and literal percent
POSIX file names preserve Unicode and percent sequences
a remote draft names host, space and document
a remote document id may itself contain slashes
a bare remote document lives in the default space
a bare remote host names the session's own document
